## Why This Question Matters

This question assesses the ability to architect offline-first data flows for field scenarios, including conflict resolution without a central server, peer-to-peer synchronization, and crash-safe resume. It requires concrete data models, a practical sync protocol, and a UI implementation.

## Key Concepts

- **Offline-First Data Model**: WorkOrder, Step, and Media entities designed for local-first operation
